task: Draft my reply to the loss adjuster asking how a cash settlement would be calculated and how long it normally takes.
text:
Claim notes so far: water damage, kitchen

Policyholder: Nguyen Minh Chau
Policy no.: HSH-2209-77814-C
Claim ref: CLM/88/40217

On 2 February the inlet hose on our washing machine split while we were out. The kitchen laminate (about 14 square metres) has lifted and the bottom of two base units is swollen. Our plumber, Fintan Gallagher, replaced the hose the same evening and wrote that the hose failed from age, not from a fitting error.

The loss adjuster, Ms Oduya, visited on 9 February. She said the flooring and units are covered under escape of water, but the washing machine itself and the hose are not, because they count as wear and tear. My excess is 350 pounds. She thought the insurer would probably offer a cash settlement rather than send their own fitters, though she couldn't promise that.

Next step: reply to her at r.oduya@adjusters.example.

task: Turn this into a short checklist for the vendor onboarding ticket showing what's done and what's still blocking the first purchase order.
text:
Subject: New supplier setup, packaging, missing items

Hi Wiktoria,

Following yesterday's call, here's what we have for the corrugated packaging supplier so far. Their account manager is Tuan Pham (tuan.pham@corrupack.example, +44 7700 900815). Remittance details from their letterhead: IBAN GB00 ZZZZ 0000 1234 5678 90, with payments going to their office at Unit 6, Kirkstall Trading Estate, Leeds LS5 3RT.

Still missing before finance will create the vendor record:
- signed supplier code of conduct
- insurance certificate showing at least 5 million pounds public liability
- second bank-detail verification call (finance needs someone other than Tuan to confirm the IBAN)

Tuan said the insurance certificate should arrive "by Friday at the latest", but the code of conduct needs their legal team and could take two weeks. Our first purchase order can't be raised until all three are in.

Thanks,
Rhys Abernethy

The done claims are 'here's what we have for the corrugated packaging supplier so far. Their account manager is' and 'Remittance details from their letterhead:' (both sit outside edited spans; optionally also 'IBAN' before the placeholder). Otherwise fine: Wiktoria, Tuan Pham/Tuan (3 mentions, one alias), Rhys Abernethy, email, phone, IBAN and supplier address protected; the 'someone other than' + alias + 'to confirm the IBAN)' attribution, the 5-million-pound liability, 'by Friday at the latest' and two-week hedge and the PO condition are all required.
